name: hexatech
description: Read CRM leads and chatbot conversations, draft email proposals, update requested lead statuses and add notes in Hexa-Tech.

interface.shortDescription: Read lead interests and chats, draft proposals, update CRM status.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Hexa-Tech staff account to review yesterday's leads, read enquiry requirements and linked chatbot messages, and prepare tailored email proposals in ChatGPT. Update CRM status only when requested, with an audit record. Email drafts are not sent. Customer, booking and internal-note tools remain available across permitted workspace brands. Access follows your account permissions.
defaultPrompt: Show yesterday's CRM leads and what they are interested in, using their chatbot conversations.
Prepare an email proposal for this lead for my review.
Help me add a note to a Hexa-Tech booking.
